title: Health Education and Promotion (DWH201): Main Exam, The 2nd April, 2019 8.06am
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM SECTION B

items.text: Define the following terms used in health promotion.
Describe FOUR fundamental conditions and resources needed for good health.
Explain the THREE basic strategies for health promotion according to Ottawa charter.
As a health educator name any FIVE of your roles.
Describe TWO approaches for health education.
Name FIVE significance of studying health education and promotion.
Highlight THREE targets of health education.
Enumerate FOUR barriers to effective communication.
Discuss the FIVE key principles of Ottawa charter of 1986 of health promotion.
Discuss the components of communication in health education.
Discuss any FIVE aims of health education and promotion.
